title_en: I saw a maiden in her room

lines.cyr: Видов мома, видов мома, леле, во одајата,
lines.lat: Vidov moma, vidov moma, lele, vo odajata,
lines.en: I saw a maiden, I saw a maiden, oh my, in her room,

lines.cyr: каде ми се, каде ми се, леле, променуват.
lines.lat: kade mi se, kade mi se, lele, promenuvat.
lines.en: where she was, oh my, where she was getting dressed.
I will sell all my belongings,

lines.cyr: Мома велит, мома велит, леле, мома говорит:
lines.lat: Moma velit, moma velit, lele, moma govorit:
lines.en: The maiden spoke, the maiden said, the maiden said:

lines.cyr: - Ој ти лудо, ој ти лудо, леле, лудо младо,
lines.lat: - Oj ti ludo, oj ti ludo, lele, ludo mlado,
lines.en: - Hey you fool, you fool, you foolish lad,
if I’m meant to be yours,
I will come only to you.

lines.cyr: Ќе ти пруснам, ќе ти пруснам, леле, во дворчето,
lines.lat: Ḱe ti prusnam, ḱe ti prusnam, lele, vo dvorčeto,
lines.en: I’ll strut in, I’ll strut in your courtyard,

lines.cyr: како кревка, како кревка, леле, еберица.
lines.lat: kako krevka, kako krevka, lele, eberica.
lines.en: like a delicate, like a delicate, golly, partridge.
I will sit at your table,

lines.cyr: Ќе ти легнам, ќе ти легнам, леле, во постељата,
lines.lat: Ḱe ti legnam, ḱe ti legnam, lele, vo posteljata,
lines.en: I will lie, I will lie, oh in your bed,

lines.cyr: како кротко, како кротко, леле, рудо јагне.
lines.lat: kako krotko, kako krotko, lele, rudo jagne.
lines.en: like a meek, like a meek, golly, young lamb.
I will lie in your bed,
